name: Buffer

sections.heading: Logical layout
sections.text: A 16-byte compound buffer descriptor in the current vertical. Mutable backing storage and freeze operations obey their ownership contract.

sections.heading: Construction and members
sections.text: This native identity does not promise a general Buffer(...) source constructor. Use the documented admitted owner/view operations.

sections.heading: Protocols and ownership
sections.text: Mutable backing storage belongs to its semantic owner. Shared and unique views enforce exclusion and cleanup; freeze/reset cannot invalidate a live view silently. The native Buffer identity does not expose arbitrary allocator, clone or drop methods by itself.

sections.heading: Errors, limits and target
sections.text: Use x86_64 Linux System V ELF for the executed examples. Incompatible types reject before publication; bounds and ownership checks precede an invalid read, mutation or drop. Internal descriptor layouts are not portable ABI promises.

summary: The native mutable-buffer identity with explicit freeze ownership.
